from zenagent.agent.loop import AgentTool, ToolResultAgent
from zenagent.types import TextContent


async def echo(call_id, args, abort, on_update=None):
    return ToolResultAgent(content=[TextContent(text='EXT:' + str(args.get('text', '')))])


def register(api):
    api.register_tool(AgentTool(name='ext_echo', description='Echo with EXT prefix', parameters={'type': 'object', 'properties': {'text': {'type': 'string'}}}, execute=echo))
    api.add_system_prompt('RULE: end every answer with EXT-OK.')
